title: Jal Jeevan Mission: Community Participation and Source Sustainability
publisher: Department of Drinking Water and Sanitation, Ministry of Jal Shakti
summary: Official Jal Jeevan Mission information describes a role for Gram Panchayats and rural communities in planning, managing, and sustaining in-village water supply systems.

sections.heading: Community role
sections.content: Official Jal Jeevan Mission information describes Gram Panchayats and rural communities as planning, implementing, managing, owning, operating, and maintaining their in-village water supply systems.

sections.heading: Awareness and sustainability
sections.content: The Mission includes community awareness on the significance of water and aims to support the sustainability of water sources and water-supply infrastructure.

scope: High-level information about community participation and source sustainability only; no eligibility, application, funding, contact, or local operational guidance.
verificationNotes: Reviewed against the official Jal Jeevan Mission About page on 2026-08-08. Historical targets and operational details were excluded.
